content: Table TABREF33 compares our results with previous works. It can be seen that our model ToBERT outperforms CNN based experiments by significant margin on CSAT and Fisher datasets. For CSAT dataset, we used multi-scale CNN (MS-CNN) as the baseline, given its strong results on Fisher and 20newsgroups. The setup was replicated from BIBREF5 for comparison. We also see that our result on 20 newsgroups is 0.6% worse than the state-of-the-art.
